svg.desc: Isometric contribution terrain for @Hashim1999164 from 2025-01-01 to 2025-12-31. 1,443 contributions across 365 active days. 2 wonders discovered. relative normalization, maximum 10. Terrain height represents contribution count; terrain colors follow the seasons. Village collection. In this landscape: 2 unique Wonders. 30 catalog types; 28 not seen here. Discovered: Saint Basil’s Cathedral (Epic); Hot spring (Rare). Seasonal auras in this landscape: Spring petals; Summer fireflies; Autumn leaves; Winter frost.
